topic.angle: Two kinds of charge and the electron/proton split

body.claim: Electric charge comes in two kinds, and like charges repel while unlike charges attract.
body.why: In ordinary matter, electrons carry negative charge and the protons in atomic nuclei carry positive charge. An object with equal numbers of each is neutral, and one with extra electrons is negative.

probes.question: An object has more electrons than protons. What is its overall charge?
True or false: two charges of the same sign attract each other.

image_brief.show: File:Van de graaff generator sm.jpg or File:Muller Van de Graaff generator demonstration.jpg shows a Van de Graaff generator demonstrating static charge

claims.claim: Like charges repel while unlike charges attract; two kinds of charge
claims.quote: Like charges repel each other and unlike charges attract each other.

claims.claim: Protons carry positive charge; electrons negative (ordinary matter)
claims.quote: positive charge is carried by the protons in the nuclei of atoms

claims.claim: Extra electrons give negative charge (body and probe 1)
claims.quote: If there are more electrons than protons in a piece of matter, it will have a negative charge

claims.claim: Equal numbers of each is neutral
claims.quote: and if there are equal numbers it will be neutral.

claims.claim: Probe 2: same-sign charges attract is false
claims.quote: Charged particles whose charges have the same sign repel one another
